subtitles.name: Subtitles
subtitles.desc: Adds a subtitle file (.srt, .vtt, .ass) to a video: burned in or as a track you can switch off.
subtitles.help: Pick a video. A file with the same name next to it (clip.srt or clip.en.srt) is suggested. The file is checked first (count, broken times, subtitles after the end of the video). Burned-in subtitles are always visible, which Reels and TikTok need; the video is re-encoded for this. A track is quick and lossless, and players can switch it on and off. Result: <name>.subtitled.mp4 or <name>.subs.mp4. Needs ffmpeg.

subtitles.summary.one: {count} subtitle, the last one ends at {last}.
subtitles.summary.other: {count} subtitles, the last one ends at {last}.

subtitles.no_cues: No subtitles were found in the file.

subtitles.after_end.one: {count} subtitle starts after the video ends.
subtitles.after_end.other: {count} subtitles start after the video ends.

subtitles.mode_track: As a track (can be switched off, fast, no re-encode)
